subject: Startups
title: HubSpot's Inbound Revolution
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on HubSpot's Inbound Revolution.

hook.text: HubSpot didn't sell software at first. It gave away free blog posts, tools, and courses. Then it sold.

buildup.text: They coined 'inbound marketing': attract customers with useful content instead of chasing them with cold calls.

discovery.text: HubSpot's blog became the top marketing resource online. Millions visited monthly, and a fraction converted to leads.

twist.text: The content was the product demo. Readers who learned marketing from HubSpot naturally wanted HubSpot's tools.

climax.text: HubSpot IPO'd in 2014 valued at $880 million. Free content built a billion-dollar sales pipeline.

punchline.text: Teach your market and they'll buy from you.
